messages:
alex: hitting an intermittent hang in the sampleapp SSE flow when reconnects get 429 + Retry-After. node & python clients. anyone run into this?

lina: yep, saw similar once — partial "data:" fragments split across connections and parser stalls. which SDK versions?

alex: node 0.9.4, python 0.7.2. repro steps: start a long stream, cut upstream, return 429 on reconnect path with Retry-After:1, client reconnects with Last-Event-Id but final event never emits. logs: 
```
[INFO] reconnecting lastEventId=msg_200
[WARN] upstream 429 Retry-After=1
DEBUG recv: "data: {\"id\":\"msg_201\",\"text\":\"He"
DEBUG recv: "llo\n\n"
ERROR parser: unexpected EOF waiting for event terminator
```

ben: sounds like two likely bugs: 1) Last-Event-Id header gets dropped during token refresh in one SDK, 2) parser doesn't persist trailing partial chunk across reconnect. also proxies can flush buffered TCP segments and cause reordered delivery.

lina: i'll add a tiny unit test and PR to preserve Last-Event-Id across refresh for python (it re-created headers on refresh before).

ben: i'll PR a parser change for node+python: treat successive `data:` lines as append-to-buffer until we see the full "\n\n" terminator; on reconnect keep trailing buffer and prepend to the next stream. also add lightweight seq/id checks: if event.id <= lastSeen -> drop duplicate; if gap > 1 -> log reorder.

alex: i'll author a flaky-proxy CI job (nginx snippet that returns 429 mid-stream) and attach a tiny repro harness so we can run locally and in CI.

ci-bot: created issue #1751 (sse-reconnect-429-partial-chunk-stall), attached logs and nginx.conf

lina: plan: lina -> python header-preserve PR; ben -> parser buffering + dup/reorder detection; alex -> flaky CI + repro. target: EOD Friday. :shipit:

ben: ack, prototype tomorrow.

alex: thanks all, will post canary results once patches land and we run staging sampleapp for 12h.
